description: This header defines the CycleClock class and related functions for accessing a cycle counter that increments at an approximately constant rate, along with licensing and platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: CycleClock
classes.description: Provides static methods to get the current cycle count and its frequency, with platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: CycleClockSource
classes.description: Allows registration of an alternate source function for the cycle count.

methods.name: CycleClock::Now
methods.description: Returns the current value of the cycle counter.

methods.name: CycleClock::Frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency at which the cycle counter increments.

methods.name: CycleClockSource::Register
methods.description: Registers an alternate source function for the cycle counter.
